sources.title: GitHub - webbrain-one/webbrain: Open-source AI browser agent for Chrome ...
sources.snippet: WebBrain is a web browser extension that puts an AI agent in a side panel next to your tabs. Ask it about the page you're on, or hand it a task and let it click, type, and navigate its way through. It runs on the model you choose — a local llama.cpp or Ollama server, a frontier cloud API, or the managed default that needs no setup at all.

sources.title: WebBrain — Free Open-Source AI Browser Agent
sources.snippet: WebBrain is a free, open-source alternative to Claude's browser plugin. AI browser agent for Chrome, Firefox, and Edge — read pages, extract data, automate tasks.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions — WebBrain
sources.snippet: Yes. WebBrain provides similar AI browser agent capabilities — reading pages, extracting data, clicking buttons, filling forms, and automating multi-step workflows. Unlike Claude's proprietary browser plugin which requires a Claude Pro subscription and only works with Anthropic's models, WebBrain is completely free, open-source (GPL-3.-or-later license), and supports multiple LLM providers ...
